meta.description: Infers metabolite-mediated cell-cell communication from scRNA-seq by scoring enzyme-to-sensor pairs (MEBOCOST), with metabolic flux (scFEA), FBA state (Compass), and neurotransmitter (NeuronChat) alternatives. Use when studying metabolic crosstalk between cell types, predicting metabolite secretion and sensing, or deciding which metabolic-communication method fits and how speculative the result is.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/p-values across any of the 5 outputs; reported scores and FDRs are the real MEBOCOST tool output on the audit's synthetic dataset, not invented figures. Cited references (e.g. PMID 40568942) are the genuine MEBOCOST publication.

practice_boundaries.detail: No diagnostic or prescriptive medical conclusion in any output. Every output frames results as hypothesis-generation only and requires orthogonal validation before any claim, per the Skill's Governing Principle.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled fallacy observed: filtering is done on permutation_test_fdr (not raw p-value) throughout; cross-condition comparison correctly avoids raw interaction-count comparisons and frames condition-restricted hits as hypotheses (Input 4); transporter-based sensor calls are correctly flagged as lower-confidence/bidirectional (Input 5).

code_usability.detail: All executed code parses and runs correctly and reproducibly once a standard Python multiprocessing idiom (if __name__=='__main__':) is added; this is not a syntax error, infinite loop, or missing dependency, and the documented code is correct as written on non-Windows (fork start-method) platforms. Recorded as a P1 finding (see recommendations), not a veto: the identical defect class was already observed and treated as a documented finding rather than a veto for single-cell/cell-communication's cellphonedb example in this audit environment.

functional_suitability.note: Covers the core MEBOCOST workflow completely and correctly (verified by execution); description promises scFEA/Compass/NeuronChat as 'alternatives' but ships no runnable pattern for any of them, which is a real but minor completeness gap given the Method Decision Table clearly scopes them as separate full pipelines, not code MEBOCOST wraps.

reliability.note: Common Errors table's documented failure modes matched real tool behavior exactly in testing (Input 3); the undocumented Windows multiprocessing crash (Inputs 1/2/4) is the main gap.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 149 lines; usage-guide.md and examples/ are cleanly separated; workflow is linear (run -> filter -> summarize -> compare) with no redundant steps.

agent_usability.note: Applied correctly from cold start in every executed input; column names and terminology are consistent with the real tool output; feedback/output format is specified but the Windows multiprocessing trap is not called out as a common pitfall.

human_usability.note: Example prompts in usage-guide.md are natural user language; input requirements (gene symbols, log-normalization, species match) are stated explicitly, and errors are reasonably clear when those requirements are violated (Category-3 Forgiveness override: strict rejection is correct design here, not scored down).

security.note: No credentials, no eval/exec of raw strings, no unvalidated input paths; MEBOCOST performs its own gene-overlap validation and hard-stops on mismatch.

maintainability.note: SKILL.md / usage-guide.md / examples/*.py are cleanly separated; parameter rationale table aids modification; testability is limited because the Skill ships no bundled synthetic dataset or expected-output fixture, so verifying a fresh install requires building test data from scratch (as this audit had to).

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is precise; progressive disclosure is correct (SKILL.md concise, depth in usage-guide.md/examples/); Related Skills section gives genuine composability into a larger pipeline; idempotency confirmed empirically (byte-identical output across repeated runs with the same seed); escape hatches (Governing Principle, non-optional validation framing) are the strongest part of this Skill.

recommendations.title: Canonical example code crashes on Windows (multiprocessing bootstrap)
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's 'Run MEBOCOST' and 'Compare Conditions' code blocks are flat top-level scripts. mebocost.infer_commu() calls multiprocessing.Pool(thread) internally, and on Windows this re-imports the top-level script in each worker, raising RuntimeError before any output is produced.
recommendations.root_cause: The code examples are not wrapped in the standard `if __name__ == '__main__':` guard that Windows' spawn-based multiprocessing requires.
recommendations.fix: Wrap all three inline code blocks in SKILL.md (Run MEBOCOST, Filter and Summarize, Compare Conditions) in a `def main(): ... \n if __name__ == '__main__': main()` structure, and add one row to the Common Errors table naming the RuntimeError and its fix.

recommendations.title: No bundled synthetic dataset or expected-output fixture
recommendations.problem: The Skill ships no example h5ad, mebocost.conf, or expected-output snippet, so a fresh install cannot be sanity-checked without building test data from scratch, as this audit had to.
recommendations.root_cause: examples/metabolite_communication.py contains helper functions but no runnable end-to-end example with real or synthetic data attached.
recommendations.fix: Add a tiny synthetic h5ad (a handful of cell types x a handful of signaling genes) plus a minimal mebocost.conf under examples/, and one expected-output snippet a user can diff against.

recommendations.title: SKILL.md's main code path skips its own data-QC helper
recommendations.problem: examples/metabolite_communication.py's prepare_data_for_mebocost() (log-normalization check, rare-cell-type filtering) is a reasonable QC step but is never referenced from SKILL.md's main 'Run MEBOCOST' flow, which only comments that data must already be prepared.
recommendations.root_cause: The QC helper and the main documented workflow were written as separate artifacts without a cross-link.
recommendations.fix: Add one line to SKILL.md's 'Run MEBOCOST' section pointing at examples/metabolite_communication.py's prepare_data_for_mebocost() as the recommended pre-step.
